title: Plegma II: Ask Me Any Cell (Easy Version)
statement: The task is to encode each cell of a 20×20 grid as a binary grid with at most 24 zeros, plus one table from S, the ones in the current rectangle, to a side to trim, so a memoryless robot ends on the cell after 38 trims. S is area minus zeros still inside, so a fixed schedule gives each step its own S band; marker zeros time side switches.
